options.name: access_level
options.description: The access level to the group. The value V(master) is an alias for V(maintainer).

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: confirm
options.description: Require confirmation.

options.name: email
options.description: The email that belongs to the user. Required only if O(state=present).

options.name: external
options.description: Define external parameter for this user.

options.name: group
options.description: ID or Full path of parent group in the form of group/name. Add user as a member to this group.

options.name: identities
options.description: List of identities to be added/updated for this user. To remove all other identities from this user, set O(overwrite_identities=true).

options.name: isadmin
options.description: Grant admin privileges to the user.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the user you want to create. Required only if O(state=present).

options.name: overwrite_identities
options.description: Overwrite identities with identities added in this module. This means that all identities that the user has and that are not listed in O(identities) are removed from the user. This is only done if a list is provided for O(identities). To remove all identities, provide an empty list.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the user. GitLab server enforces minimum password length to 8, set this value with 8 or more characters.

options.name: reset_password
options.description: Whether the user can change its password or not.

options.name: sshkey_expires_at
options.description: The expiration date of the SSH public key in ISO 8601 format C(YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). This is only used when creating or replacing SSH public keys.

options.name: sshkey_file
options.description: The SSH public key itself.

options.name: sshkey_name
options.description: The name of the SSH public key.

options.name: sshkey_update_mode
options.description: Controls how existing SSH keys with the same O(sshkey_name) are handled. Use V(create) to preserve the historical behavior and leave existing keys with the same name unchanged. Use V(update) to replace an existing key only when exactly one key with the same name exists and its key material differs. Use V(deduplicate) to delete all keys with the same name before creating the requested key. SSH key comments are ignored when comparing key material.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, delete or block a user.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.
